parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json; const cities=[...new Set((Array.isArray(body.cities)?body.cities:[]).map(x=>String(x??'').trim()).filter(Boolean))].slice(0,20); if(!cities.length) throw new Error('Informe ao menos uma cidade em cities.'); const n=Number(body.maxLeadsPerCity??10); return [{json:{cities,maxLeadsPerCity:Math.max(1,Math.min(Number.isFinite(n)?n:10,10))}}];

const input=$('Normalize Regional Request').first().json; const leads=($json.items??[]).filter(x=>!String(x.notes??'').includes('<!-- AI_ENRICHMENT_START -->')); return input.cities.map(city=>({json:{city,maxLeadsPerCity:input.maxLeadsPerCity,leads,query:`\"quero instalar energia solar\" OR \"orçamento energia solar\" OR \"sistema fotovoltaico\" \"${city}\"`}}));

const source=$('Build City Searches').item.json; const results=($json.web?.results??[]).map(x=>({title:x.title,url:x.url,description:x.description})); return [{json:{city:source.city,leads:source.leads,results}}];

parameters.jsCode: const items=$('Prepare CRM Enrichment').all(); return[{json:{status:'completed',enrichedLeads:items.filter(x=>x.json.leadId).length,message:`${items.filter(x=>x.json.leadId).length} lead(s) enriquecido(s) com pesquisa pública do Brave.`}}];
return[{json:{status:'completed',enrichedLeads:0,message:'Nenhum lead com evidência pública suficiente para esta cidade.'}}];
